title: Screw-In Tent Stakes – Ground Anchors with Thread
descriptionHtml:
Ground anchors that really hold

Regular tent stakes easily come loose in soft or sandy ground. Then the tent and the tarp flap at the slightest gust of wind.

The thread bites into the ground

These stakes are screwed into the ground with an included hex bit. The thread bites in properly and holds much better than regular straight stakes.

Features

  • Screw in for maximum grip
  • Hex bit for a power screwdriver included
  • Heavy-duty metal that lasts
  • Great in sand, loose soil and grass
  • For tents, tarps and inflatable decorations

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
